inputs: AudioState; operation,raw16-bit channel/value; twelve external source bytes plus per-byte live/saved instrument aliases; byte delay factor/calibration and packed raw register word.

effects: Low-byte volume/gain stores preserve high bytes. Instrument copies sequentially, then rereads source for programming; owner stamping and final refresh use the actual copied record. Raw channel9 rejects; effects caller stamp alias stays intact.
preconditions: Serialized ordinary SOUND RAM, disjoint machine calling frame; no observations between individual stores and ordered hardware-list delivery.

Source description immutable/disjoint from native state, aliases in -1..23; external bytes stable during copy/program phase. Bridge binds all ordinary physical source/destination overlap and offset wrap.
MMIO/VGA source bytes use literal LoadAdlibInstrument compatibility before any source read. CPU busy-loop cycles are not host wall-clock scheduling; platform owns hardware timing.

Raw packed register high/low byte order; delay zero product65536 iterations and byte MUL CF/OF.
